notes.title: 25% OFF all Fighting Fantasy Classics gamebooks to celebrate release!
notes.notes:
The day is here! Fighting Fantasy Classics is now available! To celebrate release, all DLC gamebooks are 25% off for a limited time, including previously unreleased titles such as Deathtrap Dungeon, Citadel of Chaos and City of Thieves. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/c845c8532a68c1cffa65969d888e653293aacf3c.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/ce023184868e42cf697f5e70e92973f639268a43.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/4544a6af7be95f3ead50dd5f35aa0bd0cca3ca91.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/1aae185fdf74263f7b2a733db0d979857ec9a037.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/0f2e23d609ecde890dcf7523661d75fcbf6a7ac6.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/af34603e0daf9743f412be940b6a0a9f4a91506e.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/e330b416b429126c0f9acf1f55ec366d5a1798f8.png

Fighting Fantasy gamebooks have captured the imagination of readers for many years. We know that it was the gateway into fantasy worlds and gaming for many of you out there, and we're chuffed to be the ones giving Fighting Fantasy's classic titles of the 80s and 90s a new home in your Steam library. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/856880/Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/

If you wish to try-before-you-buy, all players have access to the full-length swashbuckling pirate  gamebook Bloodbones for FREE! Bloodbones sees you take on the role of a traveller intent on their quest to track down and defeat the dread Pirate Lord Cinnabar who has been inflicting a reign of terror on the populace for years! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/357379f98053a268f71f1aa3492d61f78c403c60.png

The eight titles currently available in Fighting Fantasy Classics are just the beginning for the library. We plan to continue delivering as many classic gamebook adaptations to you as we can. 

As long as the support is there, we want to keep releasing, so please spread the word to help bring more classic titles to life. We'd love if you could vist the  Community Hub and let us know which books you'd most like to see adapted next, and what features are important to you moving forward. We'll be listening! 

To the Warlock of Firetop Mountain Kickstarter backers out there, as we mentioned in a Kickstarter update last week, we'll be mailing out your promised keys over the next few days. So keep an eye on your inbox!

We hope you enjoy your adventures in Allansia and the greater Fighting Fantasy universe! 

Best of luck, traveller.

notes.title: Goblin Scourge Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Save game news, and Free Souls! 
We have reworked our save system to solve our Steam Cloud issue as the previous fix caused issues with users playing on multiple computers. Please contact us if you still have problems saving after updating to this latest patch. Please ensure you're running the latest patch before running the game. 

Due to this some players have lost progress through the mountain. To help get everyone back on their feet, we've added a way to 'cash in' codes for souls. In this update, the options menu has an 'Enter Code' button: select this and enter IMAGOBLIN to gain 300 souls immediately!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/091e70eb8b486ff423f7999fa2b07f9a3750739b.png

We have also added a 'Load from Local' button. If you still have problems with Steam Cloud saves, you can press this to load a backup local save that isn't synced to Steam Cloud. This is only for emergency use as it will override your main local save, so use it only if you have entered the game again and find yourself with less souls or missing characters. This will only work for saved games lost in this latest update.

 Patch Notes 

- Fixed the steam cloud saving bugs

- Fixed a Linux library issue

- Fixed a interface problem with selecting the DLC characters with a gamepad. We are working on fixing other gamepad issues in a later patch.

notes.title: Controller Support Update
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that The Warlock of Firetop Mountain now features controller support! If you attended PAX Aus, you would have had a sneak preview, but we've found and squashed a few more bugs since then.

By default, the game will select Xbox Controller functionality, but if you prefer to use a Steam Controller, we recommend that you set the 'Gamepad Type' to Steam Controller for the best experience. This setting can be found under the 'Game' tab in Settings:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/ebbb48b0cbe15d22976731d24f67c254ed67adb8.png

We hope that you continue to enjoy the game, and the best of luck in your travels through Firetop Mountain. May your STAMINA never fail!

notes.title: Allansian Wanderers Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/5305f2b9c9c9216323cd4887e53c2728d5f2d015.png

The Allansian Wanderers update includes a Linux version of the game, three new playable heroes to choose from, and more!

FEATURES

    Three new playable characters, with new stories, combat moves and achievements
    Linux version of the game
    Art Gallery to keep track of illustrations you have seen
    A new feature detailing the History of Fighting Fantasy from the 1980s to today
    Timeline of Fighting Fantasy paperback releases

UPDATES

    Additional checkpoint benches to give you the upper hand against Zagor's devious traps
    Decreased the amount of souls required to purchase new heroes
    Optimizations to make more efficient use of hard disk space

NEW HEROES
Lin Wen-Wu
This reluctant warrior wishes to avenge his brother, who lost his sword arm in combat with an Orc Chieftain who makes his home in Firetop Mountain.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/15b8b824ab0ab61a638655af5d239fc7aa0a77d0.png

Malleus Malleus
A famed gladiator severely wounded by a werewolf, Malleus Malleus is cursed with lycanthropy. He must seek the werewolf before the curse cannot be cured.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/f512c2982f2fa2fb4c0c98b520c7b82aa473f461.png

Lynette Hurtado
Lynette is a guardian of the temple of the Goddess of Justice and Truth. Citizens have requested her assistance in their resistance against the cruel tyranny of the Warlock, Zagor.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/c8e93f97671431ae72e4f8768011e814eec3aad8.png

A big thank you to everyone who has given us positive reviews, provided Let's Plays, or streamed via Twitch! Special thanks to:

Ezekiel III
skinnedteen
opt1kal
arvaneleron 
grimnomancer 
firesnakearies
leth

The team has loved watching you play in the office. We hope these new additions make your visit to Firetop Mountain even more enjoyable!

Many thanks from everyone at Tin Man Games.
